SELECT r.role_id AS roleId,r.data_scope AS dataScope FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_user_role ur ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND r.status='0' AND r.del_flag='0'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_role_menu rm JOIN sys_menu m ON m.menu_id=rm.menu_id WHERE rm.role_id=r.role_id AND m.status='0' AND m.perms IN #{permission})
